memberships.page_title: Why the Nineteen-Variable Descendant Resists Compression

statement: In the displayed six-dimensional transversal, the exact rank-six cone is the reduced union V(u3,u5) union V(u0,u3) union V(u2,u5); every point integrates to an exact cubic rank-six jet, but the universal quartic cokernel functional Gamma_4 is identically -1, so no member lifts through quartic order.
